lines.en: These woods are my territory.
I tramp through leaves, and my steps sound heavy.
My claws need sharpening, I want a tree.
There are berries past the creek.
I walk the fallen logs to save my strength.
The forest smells of honey somewhere.
I press through the brush, one step at a time.

lines.zh: 这条兽径是我踩出来的
lines.en: I wore this animal trail into the ground.

lines.zh: 背上的毛被树枝刮乱了
lines.en: Branches have roughed up the fur on my back.

lines.zh: 我去河边看看有没有鱼
lines.en: I head to the river to check for fish.
It is getting dark, I should reach my den.
This tree carries my claw marks.

lines.zh: 我坐下来，把爪子搭在石头上
lines.en: I sit and rest my claws on a stone.
The hive is up high and out of reach.
The salmon in the creek are jumping well.
My nose serves me better than my eyes.

lines.zh: 树干上的树皮被我蹭掉
lines.en: I rubbed the bark right off that trunk.
That clearing in the trees is warm in the sun.
I smell woodsmoke from far away.
This bed of dry grass suits me.
Ants are crawling over my front paw.

lines.zh: 我的肚子叫得比鸟还响
lines.en: My stomach growls louder than the birds.
You are standing on my trail.
Your pack smells faintly of honey.
I am watching you, so do not move.
You are no hunter, your soles are too soft.

lines.zh: 我在闻你身上带了什么
lines.en: I am sniffing what you brought along.
Step back once, and I step back once.
You may not cut trees in these woods.
I see the axe in your hand.
Hold still, this ground belongs to a grizzly.

lines.zh: 你的火把烧得我眼睛疼
lines.en: Your torch stings my eyes.
You dared to raise a claw at me.
That arrow went into my shoulder.
The fur on my shoulder is matted flat.
I roar, and the whole forest goes quiet.
It hurts so much I tear the ground.
Do not think a wound makes me weak.
I back behind a tree to catch my breath.
I have your scent memorized now.
My hind leg has gone a little weak.
These woods will not let you leave.

lines.zh: 罐子里的甜味我隔着皮都闻到
lines.en: I smell the sweetness through your jar.
Set that honey pail down before we talk.

lines.zh: 浆果捏在手里，我看见了
lines.en: You hold berries in your hand, I noticed.

lines.zh: 你把鱼挂在树下，我走近
lines.en: You hung a fish by the tree, I am approaching.

lines.zh: 我不吃你，但我要那罐蜜
lines.en: I will not eat you, but I want the honey.
That sweet smell keeps circling you.

lines.zh: 你把东西放在地上，退开
lines.en: Put it on the ground and walk away.

lines.zh: 我的手伸向罐子，不算抢
lines.en: My paw reaches for the jar, it is not robbery.
Honey dripped on the stone, what a waste.
I lick my lips and sniff once more.
You bumped into my chest, steady yourself.

lines.zh: 我的肩膀比你的门框宽
lines.en: My shoulder is wider than your door frame.
One shove and I push you aside.
Do not walk against me, you are in the way.
My fur is all over your clothes now.
You stepped on my back paw.
Our feet sent pinecones rolling everywhere.

lines.zh: 别在我吃东西时靠过来
lines.en: Do not come close while I am eating.
Back off, I do not like being touched.
I shift one step and give you the path.
Spring is here, a boar should find a mate.
I leave claw marks high on the trunk.
A sow grazes at the forest edge.
I growl low, and she lifts her head.
We do not fight, we simply walk together.
This den will carry us through winter.

lines.zh: 幼崽生下来只有巴掌大
lines.en: The cubs will be no bigger than a paw.

lines.zh: 我把最好的浆果丛让给她
lines.en: I give her the best berry patch.

lines.zh: 别的公熊在河对岸看着
lines.en: Another boar watches from across the river.

lines.zh: 我守着洞口，不让谁靠近
lines.en: I guard the den mouth and let no one near.
I pick up the branch in my teeth.

lines.zh: 罐子太小，我爪子塞不进
lines.en: The jar is too small for my paw.
This log could be dragged to my den.
I sniffed it, it is not food.
I toss the fish onto my back.
The iron felt cold, so I dropped it.

lines.zh: 这东西咬起来有股怪味
lines.en: This thing tastes strange when I bite it.
I bury it under the fallen leaves.
I take the hive, branch and all.
My claws are clumsy, I dropped it once.
That hunter has raised his bow.
You snapped a branch of mine.
Someone has entered my den.

lines.zh: 那声枪响惊了整片林子
lines.en: That shot startled the whole forest.

lines.zh: 你手里那根长矛太扎眼
lines.en: That spear in your hand stands out.
A cub is calling, and I hear it.

lines.zh: 那家伙在翻我的浆果丛
lines.en: That one is rummaging in my berry patch.
Who is carving words into my tree?
You are ten steps from my den.

lines.zh: 那股血腥味从你那边来
lines.en: That smell of blood comes from your side.
I will not strike first, you back off.
You are holding that torch too close.
That wolf is stealing my fish.
My roar carries a long way.

lines.zh: 你在我常喝水的溪边停下了。
lines.en: You stopped by the creek where I drink.

lines.zh: 那股铁味从你身上飘过来。
lines.en: That iron smell drifts over from you.
I lower my body and inch closer.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛一直没离开你
lines.en: My eyes have not left you once.
You retreat, and I take one step.
My claws dig into the soil.
The creek blocks you, I go around it.

lines.zh: 树后那条路我已经堵上
lines.en: I have already blocked the path behind the tree.
I can smell that you are shaking.
Do not run uphill, that way is a dead end.

lines.zh: 我一巴掌能拍断这棵苗
lines.en: One swipe of mine could snap this sapling.
Back to the river and you have no way out.
I stand up, taller than any stump.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸声你该听见了
lines.en: You should hear my breathing by now.

lines.zh: 你换手拿武器，我看见了
lines.en: You switched hands on your weapon, I saw.
One more step and I stop being patient.

lines.zh: 我绕到上风口，你闻不到我。
lines.en: I circle upwind, where you cannot smell me.

lines.zh: 你背靠那棵树，我不喜欢。
lines.en: You put your back to that tree. I dislike it.
The slope is slick and your feet tremble.

lines.zh: 我一步一步压，不急着扑。
lines.en: I close in step by step, in no hurry.
Your spear is up, and its tip is shaking.

lines.zh: 我吼一声，林子的鸟都飞了。
lines.en: I roar once and the whole forest takes flight.

lines.zh: 我一掌拍下去，土都震了
lines.en: One paw strike and the ground shakes.

lines.zh: 我的爪子划开了你的皮甲
lines.en: My claws tore through your leather armor.

lines.zh: 这一撞把你顶到树干上
lines.en: This charge slams you against a trunk.
Six points of force, you cannot take it.
I clamp down on your bracer and hold.
You fall into the brush, and I do not stop.
My forepaw is heavier than your shield.

lines.zh: 这一下打得你后退三步
lines.en: That blow knocked you back three steps.
I twist my head and throw you aside.
The smell of blood heats my ears.
Do not play dead, I can tell.
I lunge and pin down your leg.

lines.zh: 我的牙齿咬碎了你的木盾
lines.en: My teeth splintered your wooden shield.

lines.zh: 这一掌拍断了那根长矛
lines.en: This swipe snapped that spear in two.
My jaws close on your calf.

lines.zh: 这一掌把你按进了草里。
lines.en: This paw pins you into the grass.
My claws rake past your face.
The charge knocks you into the creek.

lines.zh: 我压住你的肩，不让你起身。
lines.en: I hold your shoulder and you cannot rise.

lines.zh: 我甩了下头，血溅到树皮上。
lines.en: I shake my head and blood hits the bark.

lines.zh: 我从林子深处的洞里出来
lines.en: I come out of a den deep in the woods.
The trees in this forest grow thick.
I shake the leaves off my back.
My winter den stood empty all season.
I smell pine resin and wet earth.
The water source is not far from here.
The canopy is too thick for light.
My tracks are pressed into the moss.

lines.zh: 这片林子没有别的公熊
lines.en: No other boar claims this forest.
I stretch, and my bones crack.
The berries at the forest edge are ripe.
I step out from the shadow of the trees.
Flame singed my fur, and I roar.

lines.zh: 摔下来，我压断了一丛灌木
lines.en: I fell and crushed a whole bush.
Water fills my nose, I paddle hard.
The blast left my ears ringing.
Another arrow stuck in my thick fur.

lines.zh: 那道光让我的毛立起来
lines.en: That light made my fur stand up.
Three days without fish, my legs feel heavy.
Lightning split the tree beside me.
The ground vanished, and I caught nothing.
